_comment: Deployment roles, the SeisComp way: same binaries, a role is just a set of enabled modules plus a few parameters. `terrapulse setup --role <name>` writes etc/enabled.json (site state). Module start arguments are built from these params by etc/init/<module>.py start_args(env).

standalone.description: Everything on one machine (demo / development): broker, SeedLink backbone, a simulated source, and the full processing tier.

center.description: Object monitoring centre: broker, backbone server, processing and web services. No local source - field nodes feed it over the LAN.

hub.description: Field node next to the sensors: acquisition only, feeds the centre over SeedLink (push). The lightest build (TP_BUILD_GUI=OFF).

processor.description: Dedicated processing node: reads the centre's backbone and handles one station partition.

playback.description: Replay archived data as if it were live, for tests and presentations.

gui.description: Operator workstation. GUI views are not daemons - run them with `terrapulse exec tprttv|tpmap|tpolv|tpconfig`.
